title: No database – data lives in JSON files
context: The app is a prototype for exploring the triage workflow; persistence and multi-user editing are out of scope.
decision: Store requests, themes and decisions in /data/*.json and read them at build time. Revisit once editing from the UI is needed.

title: Themes reference requests, not the other way round
context: Many incoming requests describe the same underlying need in different words, and raw requests should stay exactly as the client sent them.
decision: Each theme lists its requestIds. Requests not listed by any theme are shown as untriaged. A theme owns the requirement doc and moves across the board.

title: Next.js App Router with Server Components
context: Pages are read-only views over static data.
decision: Render pages as Server Components; only the navigation is a Client Component (for active-link state).

title: Fictional tour-operator demo data
context: Real client requests cannot be published in a public repository.
decision: Use 22 made-up requests from 6 fictional tour operators, marked as fictional in the JSON files and in a banner on every page.
